OBA.1.1-2.text: The LORD will make Edom small among the nations

OBA.1.3-4.text: The LORD will bring proud Edom down from the heights

OBA.1.5-6.text: Edom will be robbed worse than by thieves

OBA.1.7-9.text: Allies will betray Edom and its wise men will fall

OBA.1.10-11.text: Edom will be shamed for standing aside when Jacob suffered

OBA.1.12-14.text: Edom should not have gloated when Judah was in trouble

OBA.1.15-16.text: The Day of the LORD is near for all nations

OBA.1.17-18.text: Zion will be safe, and Edom will be destroyed

OBA.1.19-19.text: Israel will take the lands of Edom and the Philistines

OBA.1.20-21.text: Israel’s exiles will take new land, and the LORD will rule
